pairs.evidence: src/features/onboarding/components/AppearanceStep.tsx:14 still hand-lists 11 of the 14 manifest locales (no bn/id/vi); now hidden behind UI_LANGUAGE_PICKER_ENABLED, but the manifest revive procedure (src/i18n/locales.manifest.ts:63) re-shows this picker without bn/id/vi, and src/features/home/sub_welcome/LanguageSwitcher.tsx:16 is a second shadow list

techniques.evidence: src/features/onboarding/components/AppearanceStep.tsx:14 shadow language list; src/i18n/locales.manifest.ts:14 claims no other file references a locale by code, which is false; reviving a language still means editing these lists plus the lefthook/ci gates the manifest names, so the one-line-diff test fails
src/i18n/locales.manifest.ts:73 toShippedUiLocale sends any persisted or requested unshipped language to English, so no switcher offers a language the bundle cannot serve
src/i18n/pseudoLocale.ts:2 dev-only pseudo-locale is generated from the English bundle at runtime, with no engine, and stays out of the coverage gate
src/i18n/locales.manifest.ts:70 SHIPPED_UI_LOCALES is ['en'], so no shipped catalog makes a translatedness claim to audit

pairs.registryProposal: language-registry-single-source could name the shipped-subset case: a registry with a known set (LOCALES) and a shipped subset (SHIPPED_UI_LOCALES) where a dormant UI surface hides its shadow list until revival. That drift cannot be seen at runtime and only shows on the day a language is revived.

pairs.evidence: src/lib/personas/templates/templateOverlays.ts:273 the overlay import.meta.glob still hand-lists 13 per-language patterns; the code set is derived (line 270) and a test asserts coverage, but adding a manifest language still requires editing this file, so the one-line-diff test fails (file unchanged since 2026-08-28)

techniques.evidence: src/lib/personas/templates/templateOverlays.ts:273 static glob literal per language; a drift test (src/lib/personas/templates/__tests__/templateOverlays.test.ts:15) catches drift but does not remove the edit

pairs.registryProposal: language-registry-single-source has no ruling for build-tool constraints that require static literals (Vite import.meta.glob). It should say whether a generated glob is required or whether a parity test that fails on drift is an acceptable second-best.
